name: Accordion
layerWhy: It discloses detail; reading it is not a job.
promise: Each summary opens the detail under it, without moving what I'm reading.
expectation: Summaries one under the other with a chevron that turns.
evidence: Native <details>: it works without script, is found by the browser's search, and same-named ones open one at a time.
behaviour: Enter or Space on a summary toggles it.
context: Answers people skim, settings people rarely open.
dont: An accordion around a whole page.
